subject: Open-source GitHub integration — demo & onboarding sync
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@openforge.dev>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@lumenops.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in Redwood GitHub app + demo request

Hi Hannah,

We signed up for Redwood's free tier yesterday after seeing the GitHub app listing — excited to try it. A couple quick context points: OpenForge is an OSS maintainer org (40+ repos) and we're evaluating ways to host a smart code-assistant and use Redwood for inference in CI for code suggestions and PR triage.

Before we book deep technical time, could we get a 30-minute walkthrough that covers:
- Brief overview of the GitHub App permissions model and webhook scopes;
- How Redwood handles repo-level tokens vs org-level installation;
- What the onboarding looks like for self-serve teams with several repos;
- Any recommended config for low-cost inference in CI.

We're available Thurs 6/24 after 10am PT or Fri 6/25 between 9–12pm PT. I've attached a rough diagram of our repo layout. Priya (cc'd) is our engineering lead and will join if possible.

Thanks,
Samir
Co-founder, OpenForge
[Attachment: repo-integration-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@openforge.dev>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Nair <priya@lumenops.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood GitHub app + demo request

Thanks for the note, Samir — great to meet you (virtually).

Happy to run a 30-min session that covers exactly those bullets. Ben (Solutions Eng) is cc'd and will join to go through webhook scopes and token patterns.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu 6/24 — 10:30am, 11:30am
- Fri 6/25 — 9:00am, 10:30am

If any of those work, pick a slot or drop a time that fits and I'll send an invite with an agenda. Also helpful if you can share which GitHub org role the installer will have (org admin vs repo admin).

I've attached a short SOW template we share for larger pilots — just for reference, no action needed.

Agenda (proposed):
1) Quick intros & goals (5m)
2) GitHub App perms + onboarding options (10m)
3) Deployment choices (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and cost levers (10m)
4) Next steps + trial plan (5m)

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sow-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Samir Patel <samir@openforge.dev>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@lumenops.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood GitHub app + demo request

Hi Hannah — thanks, that looks good. Fri 6/25 at 10:30am PT works for us, and Priya will invite our CTO, Maya, to join.

One extra ask: could Ben briefly touch on webhook retry behavior and secrets rotation in the call? We had a nasty incident with a third-party webhook earlier and want to make sure we design around retries/idempotency.

See you Friday — Samir
